brief: Preserve the initial outdoor campfire, add an enterable mural cave immediately behind it, and connect a gentle southern mountain trail to the existing White Feather castle. Keep northern snow access and surrounding circulation.
userClarification: カラスの巣は白羽教団の大聖城を指す。
sourcePolicy: Keep original reference, dense reconstruction, every processing revision and Blender files. Weld matching source UV-seam vertices before QEM. No visible primitive replacements, no Claude, no Tripo.

murals.method: Generated ochre and charcoal pigment projected onto existing cave wall triangles; faint daylight with actual warm point lighting when the separate cave hearth is lit.

retainedFailures: Cave direct dense Blender reduction interrupted before completion; cave UV-bake r03/r04 rejected; all earlier terrain fitting and reduction revisions retained.
userCorrection: 大きい自然な山と高台に洞窟。洞窟は行き止まりでよい。川を避けるか移す。
userRefinement: 洞窟を約2倍に延ばし壁画を最奥へ。川を埋めた箇所で沈む不具合、山の裂け目、洞窟内外の床・色・境界を滑らかに修正。
